programmes.name_en: Bolsa Família cash transfer programme (successor of Auxílio Brasil)
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS) / Caixa Econômica Federal
programmes.amount_note: Minimum of R$ 600 per family (Benefício Complementar tops up to R$ 600). Composition: R$ 142 per member (Benefício de Renda de Cidadania) + R$ 150 per child aged 0-6 (Benefício Primeira Infância) + R$ 50 per pregnant woman, nursing mother or member aged 7-17 (Benefício Variável Familiar).
programmes.deadline_note: Monthly payments by NIS final digit; family must keep CadÚnico updated (every 2 years) and comply with health/school conditionalities.

procedure_steps.detail: Register or update the family in the Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) at the CRAS of your municipality
MDS selects eligible families automatically from CadÚnico data; check status in the Bolsa Família/Caixa Tem app
Receive monthly payment via Caixa Tem app, Bolsa Família card or Caixa branches

documents_required.doc: CPF or identity document of the family representative
Documents of all family members (CPF/birth certificate)

eligibility.income_note: Per capita family income up to R$ 218 per month; families in poverty or extreme poverty registered in CadÚnico

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício de Renda de Cidadania – BRC, no valor de R$ 142,00 por integrante da família... Benefício Complementar pago às famílias que receberem valor inferior a R$ 600,00.

programmes.name_en: Continuous Benefit Payment (BPC) - social assistance pension for elderly 65+ and persons with disabilities
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (MDS), operado pelo INSS
programmes.amount_note: One national minimum wage per month (R$ 1.518 in 2025; reajustado anualmente). No 13th salary and no survivor's pension.
programmes.deadline_note: Requires CadÚnico updated within the last 2 years; review every 2 years.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS of your municipality
Apply via Meu INSS (site/app), Central 135 or at an INSS agency
For persons with disabilities: attend medical and biopsychosocial assessment at INSS
Receive monthly payment through the bank indicated by INSS

eligibility.income_note: Persons aged 65+ OR persons with long-term disability of any age; per capita family income up to 1/4 of the minimum wage (may be flexibilised in court)

programmes.source_snippet: Garante um salário mínimo mensal ao idoso com 65 anos ou mais e à pessoa com deficiência cuja renda familiar per capita não ultrapasse 1/4 do salário mínimo, sem exigir contribuição ao INSS.

programmes.name_en: Inclusion Allowance for persons with disabilities entering formal work
programmes.funder: INSS (benefício assistencial, Lei nº 13.146/2015, regulamentado pelo Decreto nº 10.919/2021)
programmes.amount_note: 50% of the national minimum wage per month (R$ 759 in 2025) while the person works formally with pay up to 2 minimum wages.
programmes.deadline_note: BPC can be reinstated if the job ends, without a new full process.

procedure_steps.detail: Be a current or recent (last 5 years) BPC recipient with moderate or severe disability
Start formal employment with remuneration up to 2 minimum wages; BPC is suspended
Request Auxílio-Inclusão via Meu INSS, Central 135 or INSS agency

eligibility.income_note: Persons with moderate/severe disability who receive or received BPC in the last 5 years; employment income up to 2 minimum wages per month

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício pago pelo INSS para pessoas com deficiência que recebem ou já receberam o BPC... trabalhador passa a receber 50% do salário mínimo como incentivo financeiro.

programmes.name_local: Programa Gás do Povo (ex-Auxílio Gás dos Brasileiros)
programmes.name_en: People's Gas Programme - free LPG cylinder refills for low-income families
programmes.funder: MDS / Ministério de Minas e Energia (Lei nº 15.348/2026, ex-MP 1.313/2025); operado pela Caixa e Dataprev
programmes.amount_note: Free 13 kg LPG cylinder refills: up to 4 per year for families of 2-3 persons (one every 3 months) and up to 6 per year for families of 4+ persons. Replaces the old Auxílio Gás cash payment (about R$ 102-110 bimonthly), being phased out by 2027.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic monthly selection from CadÚnico subject to budget availability; no application needed.

procedure_steps.detail: Register and keep CadÚnico updated (data updated within the last 24 months) at the CRAS
MDS selects families automatically; check the Gás do Povo app or Caixa Tem
Redeem the free refill at a credentialed reseller using the Bolsa Família card, Caixa debit card or CPF + SMS code

documents_required.doc: CPF of the family representative regularised

eligibility.income_note: Per capita family income up to half the minimum wage (R$ 810,50 in 2026); Bolsa Família families have priority

programmes.source_snippet: Com o Programa Gás do Povo, a família beneficiária recebe um vale para realizar a recarga gratuita do botijão de gás de 13kg em uma revenda varejista credenciada.

programmes.name_en: Occasional Benefits - one-off municipal social assistance grants (birth, death, calamity, temporary vulnerability)
programmes.funder: Municípios (fundos municipais de assistência social), no âmbito do SUAS/MDS
programmes.amount_note: Amount set by each municipality; modalities include birth benefit (auxílio-natalidade), death benefit (auxílio-funeral) and aid in situations of calamity or temporary vulnerability.
programmes.deadline_note: Requested at the CRAS/CREAS of the municipality of residence.

procedure_steps.detail: Go to the CRAS of your municipality and request the occasional benefit
Social service evaluates the situation of vulnerability
Payment made according to municipal rules (cash, voucher or in-kind)

documents_required.doc: Proof of the situation (birth/death certificate, calamity report)

eligibility.income_note: Families in situation of poverty or temporary vulnerability; criteria defined by each municipality under LOAS

programmes.source_snippet: Os benefícios eventuais são garantias previstas na Lei Orgânica da Assistência Social (Lei nº 8.742/1993) para suprir necessidades transitórias de vulnerabilidade, como nascimento, morte e calamidades.

programmes.name_en: Family Salary - INSS per-child supplement for low-wage workers
programmes.funder: INSS (pago pelo empregador e descontado da GPS)
programmes.amount_note: R$ 65,00 per month per child under 14 or disabled child of any age (2025 value, Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF nº 2/2025).
programmes.deadline_note: Paid monthly with the salary; suspended when the child turns 14 or employment ends.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the request to your employer with the children's documents
Domestic workers, unemployed and individual contributors request directly at INSS (Meu INSS/135)
Present annually proof of school attendance (from age 6) and vaccination (up to age 6)

eligibility.income_note: Monthly remuneration up to R$ 1.906,04 (2025 ceiling); employees, domestic workers, individual contributors and avulsos

programmes.source_snippet: O trabalhador com renda bruta de até R$ 1.906,04 tem direito a receber R$ 65,00 por filho ou dependente, mensalmente.

programmes.name_en: Survivor's Pension (INSS)
programmes.funder: INSS (Regime Geral de Previdência Social)
programmes.amount_note: Family share: 50% of the deceased's retirement/benefit value + 10% per dependent (up to 100%); minimum of one minimum wage (R$ 1.518 in 2025).

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS (site/app) or Central 135
INSS analyses dependency and the deceased's insured status
Payment to dependents in the legal order (spouse/partner, children, parents, siblings)

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity of the dependent

eligibility.income_note: No income test. The INSS pensão por morte page publishes no income ceiling for dependants or the household — requirements are that the deceased was an insured person and that dependant status is proven. 2026.

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício previdenciário pago aos dependentes do segurado da Previdência Social que falecer, conforme Lei nº 8.213/1991.

programmes.name_en: Maternity Pay (INSS), including unemployed and individual contributors
programmes.funder: INSS (para empregadas, pago pelo empregador; demais seguradas, pago diretamente pelo INSS)
programmes.amount_note: 120 days of the full salary for employees; for unemployed, individual, optional and special insureds, 1/12 of the average of last contributions, minimum one minimum wage (R$ 1.518 in 2025).
programmes.deadline_note: Request between the birth/adoption and the child's 5th birthday; unemployed insureds must request via Meu INSS.

procedure_steps.detail: Employees: inform the employer from the 28th week of pregnancy or at birth
Unemployed/individual contributors: request via Meu INSS or Central 135 after birth
INSS pays 120 days (up to 180 for employers in Empresa Cidadã)

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity of the mother

eligibility.income_note: Insured women (employed, domestic, individual, optional, unemployed within the grace period); also for adoption and legal custody; no minimum contribution for employees, 10 months for individual/optional

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício previdenciário de 120 dias pago à segurada por ocasião do nascimento do filho, adoção ou guarda judicial para fins de adoção.

programmes.name_en: Temporary Incapacity Benefit (former sickness benefit)
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 91% of the 'salário de benefício', limited to the average of the insured's contribution salaries; minimum of one minimum wage.
programmes.deadline_note: Requires INSS medical expertise (perícia); waiting period of 12 contributions (waived for accidents/listed diseases).

procedure_steps.detail: Schedule medical expertise via Meu INSS or Central 135
Attend the perícia with medical documents proving the incapacity
If granted, receive monthly while the temporary incapacity lasts

documents_required.doc: Medical reports and exams proving incapacity

eligibility.income_note: INSS insured temporarily unable to work for more than 15 consecutive days; employees receive the first 15 days from the employer

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício devido ao segurado que ficar temporariamente incapaz para o trabalho por motivo de doença ou acidente, por mais de 15 dias consecutivos.

programmes.name_local: Aposentadoria por Incapacidade Permanente (ex-Aposentadoria por Invalidez)
programmes.name_en: Permanent Incapacity Retirement (former disability retirement)
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 60% of the average contribution salary + 2% per year above 20 (men) / 15 (women) years of contribution; 100% of the average in case of work accident; minimum of one minimum wage.
programmes.deadline_note: Requires INSS medical expertise; may add 25% if permanent assistance of a third person is needed.

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Attend medical expertise proving permanent incapacity without rehabilitation to another occupation
Receive monthly retirement; may include the 25% supplement

documents_required.doc: Medical documentation of the permanent incapacity

eligibility.income_note: INSS insured permanently unable to work and not rehabilitatable to another occupation; 12-contribution waiting period (waived for accidents/listed diseases)

programmes.source_snippet: Será concedida ao segurado que, cumprida a carência, for considerado incapaz e insuscetível de reabilitação para o exercício de atividade que lhe garanta a subsistência.

programmes.name_en: Accident Aid - INSS compensation for permanent reduction of work capacity
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: 50% of the value that would be the permanent incapacity retirement; paid monthly until retirement age. Compatible with continued work.
programmes.deadline_note: Granted after consolidation of sequelae from an accident of any nature.

procedure_steps.detail: Request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Medical expertise confirms permanent sequelae that reduce work capacity
Receive monthly supplement until retirement

eligibility.income_note: Employed insureds (including domestic and special) with permanent reduction of work capacity after an accident

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício de natureza indenizatória pago ao segurado empregado que, após acidente, ficar com sequelas permanentes que reduzam a capacidade para o trabalho.

programmes.name_en: Incarceration Aid - INSS benefit for dependents of low-income prisoners
programmes.funder: INSS
programmes.amount_note: Value proportional to the prisoner's contribution salary, minimum one minimum wage; paid to dependents while the insured remains in closed-regime custody.
programmes.deadline_note: Only for closed-regime imprisonment of a low-income insured; ceases with release or regime progression.

procedure_steps.detail: Dependents request via Meu INSS or Central 135
Prove the insured status and low-income condition of the prisoner
Receive monthly while closed-regime custody lasts; inform any change

documents_required.doc: Proof of low income of the insured at the time of incarceration

eligibility.income_note: INSS publishes a valor limite of R$1,980.38 per month from 01/01/2026 (Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF n.º 13): the imprisoned insured's average contribution salary must not exceed it. R$1,980.38 x 12 = R$23,764.56/year. This is the insured person's own contribution wage, not total household income.

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício previdenciário pago aos dependentes do segurado de baixa renda recolhido à prisão em regime fechado (Lei nº 8.213/1991, art. 80).

programmes.name_en: Unemployment Insurance
programmes.funder: Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (Fundo de Amparo ao Trabalhador - FAT); pago pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: 3 to 5 monthly instalments depending on time worked; minimum one minimum wage (R$ 1.518) and maximum R$ 2.424,11 (2025 table). Fishermen, domestic workers and rescued workers have specific rules.
programmes.deadline_note: Request from the 7th to the 120th day after dismissal (employed workers).

procedure_steps.detail: Request via the Carteira de Trabalho Digital app, gov.br portal or Agências do Trabalho
Present the requerimento/CD form given by the employer
Receive 3 to 5 instalments via Caixa (Caixa Tem, branches or account credit)

documents_required.doc: Requerimento do Seguro-Desemprego (form CD) delivered by employer

eligibility.income_note: Formal workers dismissed without just cause; first request requires at least 12 months of work in the last 18 months; no other income for own subsistence

programmes.source_snippet: Valor mínimo do seguro desemprego é de R$ 1.518 em 2025... quem ganha acima de R$ 3.564,96: o valor será sempre de R$ 2.424,11.

programmes.name_en: Annual salary bonus PIS/PASEP
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (FAT); PIS pago pela Caixa, PASEP pelo Banco do Brasil
programmes.amount_note: Up to one minimum wage per year, proportional to months worked in the base year (1/12 per month); 2025 values of R$ 126,50 to R$ 1.518.
programmes.deadline_note: Payment calendar each year (usually February to August); unclaimed amounts can be requested later within the legal deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility in the Carteira de Trabalho Digital app or gov.br portal
Private-sector workers receive at Caixa (Caixa Tem); public servants at Banco do Brasil
Withdraw within the calendar year

documents_required.doc: Registration in PIS/PASEP for at least 5 years

eligibility.income_note: Worked at least 30 days with formal contract in the base year with average pay up to 2 minimum wages; registered in PIS/PASEP for 5+ years; employer data in RAIS/eSocial

programmes.source_snippet: O valor do abono salarial é proporcional aos meses trabalhados, com base no salário mínimo; cada mês trabalhado equivale a 1/12 do salário mínimo.

programmes.name_local: FGTS - Modalidades de Saque (Saque-Aniversário, Rescisão, Calamidade)
programmes.name_en: FGTS withdrawal modalities (anniversary withdrawal, dismissal, calamity)
programmes.funder: Caixa Econômica Federal (agente operador do FGTS)
programmes.amount_note: Saque-rescisão: full balance on dismissal without just cause (+40% fine paid by employer). Saque-aniversário: annual withdrawal of a percentage (5% to 50%) of the balance in the birthday month. Saque calamidade: up to R$ 6.200 per account in municipalities with recognised state of calamity (up to 3 withdrawals per year).
programmes.deadline_note: Saque-aniversário option made in the FGTS app; returning to saque-rescisão has a 24-month grace period.

procedure_steps.detail: Install the FGTS app and check your balance
Choose the withdrawal modality (saque-aniversário or keep saque-rescisão)
For calamity: request in the app when the municipality decree is recognised by Caixa

documents_required.doc: For calamity: declaration of residence in the affected municipality

eligibility.income_note: Workers with FGTS accounts (active or inactive); specific rules per modality

programmes.source_snippet: O trabalhador pode sacar o FGTS nas modalidades saque-rescisão, saque-aniversário, saque calamidade e demais hipóteses legais, conforme regras do Conselho Curador do FGTS.

programmes.name_en: Closed-season insurance for artisanal fishers
programmes.funder: INSS / Ministério da Pesca e Aquicultura
programmes.amount_note: One minimum wage per month (R$ 1.518 in 2025) during the defeso (closed fishing season), usually 3-4 instalments per year.
programmes.deadline_note: Request during the closed season defined for each species/region; requires RGP registration at least 3 years before (gradual rules).

procedure_steps.detail: Be registered as artisanal fisher (RGP) with the Ministério da Pesca
Prove artisanal fishing activity and no other remunerated activity
Request via Meu INSS/135 during the defeso period

documents_required.doc: Proof of fishing activity (colônia registration, sales notes)

eligibility.income_note: Artisanal fishers working individually or in family economy regime, without other remunerated activity or benefit

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício previdenciário de um salário mínimo mensal pago ao pescador profissional artesanal durante o período de defeso (proibição de pesca).

programmes.name_en: Athlete Grant Programme for high-performance athletes
programmes.funder: Ministério do Esporte; Caixa como agente pagador
programmes.amount_note: Monthly values by category (2024/2025): Base and Estudantil R$ 410; Nacional R$ 1.025; Internacional R$ 2.051; Olímpico/Paralímpico/Surdolímpico R$ 3.437; Pódio up to R$ 16.629. Paid for 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual application window via Sistema Bolsa Atleta (usually Jan-Feb); results published in lists.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply in the annual window at the Sistema Bolsa Atleta with gov.br login
Submit results from the previous year recognised by the Ministry
If selected, sign the term of adhesion within 30 days and receive 12 monthly instalments

documents_required.doc: Proof of sports results (official competition placements)

eligibility.income_note: Athletes in Olympic, Paralympic, Deaflympic and recognised non-Olympic modalities with results in the previous year; no income test (programme for athletes without sponsorship)

programmes.source_snippet: O valor da Bolsa Atleta varia de R$ 410,00 até R$ 16.629,00, conforme categoria do atleta... O pagamento é realizado pelo período de 12 meses.

programmes.name_en: Training Grant for workers in professional qualification courses
programmes.funder: Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (FAT)
programmes.amount_note: One minimum wage per month (R$ 1.518 in 2025) during the qualification course; unemployment insurance instalments are suspended and preserved while in training.
programmes.deadline_note: Offered together with unemployment insurance at Agências do Trabalho/SINE.

procedure_steps.detail: When applying for unemployment insurance, manifest interest in a qualification course
Enrol in a course of the Plano de Qualificação (Pronatec/Rede Federal or contracted institutions)
Receive one minimum wage monthly for the duration of the course

eligibility.income_note: Workers entitled to unemployment insurance who enrol in professional qualification courses

programmes.source_snippet: O trabalhador em situação de desemprego pode receber bolsa-formação de um salário mínimo durante curso de qualificação profissional, com suspensão das parcelas do seguro-desemprego.

programmes.name_en: Social Electricity Tariff - discounts on power bills for low-income families
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Lei nº 12.212/2010, alterada pela Lei nº 15.235/2025); regulada pela ANEEL e aplicada pelas distribuidoras
programmes.amount_note: Progressive discounts on the residential tariff: 65% up to 30 kWh/month, 40% from 31 to 100 kWh, 10% from 101 to 220 kWh; indigenous and quilombola families have 100% up to 50 kWh. Lei 15.235/2025 added 100% exemption up to 80 kWh/month for eligible low-income families.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically to the electricity bill after CadÚnico/INSS data cross-check; if not applied, request at the distributor with the NIS number.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in CadÚnico (CRAS) or be a BPC beneficiary
Discount is applied automatically to the bill of the residence
If not applied, contact the power distributor with the NIS/Benefit number

documents_required.doc: CadÚnico registration (NIS) or BPC benefit number
CPF of the electricity bill holder

eligibility.income_note: ANEEL: families in CadÚnico with monthly per-capita household income of at most half the national minimum wage. 2026 minimum wage = R$1,621.00, so half = R$810.50/month per person; x12 = R$9,726/year per person. A separate route covers CadÚnico families up to 3 minimum wages/month where a member depends on continuous electrically powered medical equipment.

programmes.source_snippet: Descontos de 65% para famílias com consumo de até 30 kWh por mês; 40% para consumo entre 31 e 100 kWh; 10% entre 101 e 220 kWh.

programmes.name_en: My Home My Life - Band 1 subsidised housing for lowest-income families
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa (recursos FGTS e Orçamento da União)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy (aporte) of up to R$ 55.000 plus reduced interest (around 4% a.a.) for families with monthly income up to R$ 2.850; financing up to 95% of the property value. Programme resumed in 2023 (Resolução CCI/FGTS).
programmes.deadline_note: Selection done by municipalities/states (social selection) or directly at developers for subsidised units.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in the municipal housing secretariat selection (CadÚnico-based) or look for MCMV Faixa 1 developments
Be indicated by the public entity or approved by Caixa credit analysis
Sign the subsidised financing contract at Caixa

documents_required.doc: CPF and identity documents of the family

eligibility.income_note: Gross monthly family income up to R$ 2.850; priority to families in vulnerable situations, women-headed households and persons in situation of risk

programmes.source_snippet: Faixa 1 - até R$ 2.850,00 - aporte máximo até R$ 55 mil; famílias com renda mensal bruta de até R$ 8.600,00 podem participar do MCMV.

programmes.name_local: Minha Casa, Minha Vida - Faixas 2 e 3 (Urbano)
programmes.name_en: My Home My Life - Bands 2 and 3 subsidised housing finance
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa (FGTS)
programmes.amount_note: Faixa 2 (income R$ 2.850,01 to R$ 4.700): subsidy up to R$ 55 mil in some modalities and reduced interest (~7,66% a.a.); Faixa 3 (R$ 4.700,01 to R$ 8.600): subsidy up to R$ 20-35 mil with market-linked FGTS rates.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply directly at Caixa or at developers of MCMV projects; credit analysis required.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose an MCMV development and check the income band
Do a housing credit simulation and analysis at Caixa
Sign the subsidised FGTS financing contract

documents_required.doc: Proof of income (payslips, bank statements for self-employed)
Property documents of the chosen unit

eligibility.income_note: Gross monthly family income from R$ 2.850,01 to R$ 8.600; cannot own another residential property in the same municipality

programmes.source_snippet: Faixa 2: R$ 2.850,01 a R$ 4.700,00 - até R$ 35 mil de aporte; Faixa 3: R$ 4.700,01 a R$ 8.600,00 - até R$ 20 mil.

programmes.name_en: My Home My Life Rural - housing subsidy for rural families
programmes.funder: Ministério das Cidades; operado pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy for construction, renovation or expansion of rural housing for families with income up to R$ 2.850/month who work in rural activities; operation via state/municipal entities or rural producers' organisations.
programmes.deadline_note: Families are organised and indicated by the executing public entity (state/municipality) or rural unions.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the municipal housing/rural development secretariat
Entity submits the project to Caixa/Ministério das Cidades
Approved families receive the subsidy for construction or renovation

documents_required.doc: Proof of rural activity (DAP, CAR or union declaration)
Proof of land ownership or authorised possession

eligibility.income_note: Rural families with monthly income up to R$ 2.850 working in agriculture, fishing, extractivism; tenure of the rural land required

programmes.source_snippet: Modalidade rural do programa habitacional destinada a famílias que vivem no campo e exercem atividade agropecuária, pesqueira ou extrativista.

programmes.name_en: Pé-de-Meia student savings incentive for low-income public high school students
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (MEC); contas abertas automaticamente pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Incentivo Frequência: up to 9 instalments of R$ 200/year (80% attendance). Plus Incentivo Matrícula R$ 200/year, Incentivo Conclusão R$ 1.000 per completed year (savings, released after graduation) and Incentivo Enem R$ 200.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic enrolment from school network data; students must be enrolled in public high school or EJA and in CadÚnico.

procedure_steps.detail: Be enrolled in public high school/EJA and registered in CadÚnico
Caixa opens the digital savings account automatically; guardian consent needed under 18
Track balances in the Pé-de-Meia/Caixa Tem app; savings released after high school completion

documents_required.doc: Enrolment in a public high school or EJA

eligibility.income_note: Students aged 14-24 in public high school or EJA registered in CadÚnico

programmes.source_snippet: Estudantes do ensino médio regular poderão receber até nove parcelas de R$ 200 ao longo do ano, mediante comprovação de frequência.

programmes.name_local: Fundo de Financiamento Estudantil (Fies / Novo Fies / Fies Social)
programmes.name_en: Student Financing Fund (Fies) - government-backed tuition financing
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (FNDE); Caixa como agente operador
programmes.amount_note: Financing of up to 100% of tuition with zero interest for students with per capita family income up to 3 minimum wages (Fies Social/zero interest modalities); P-Fies at variable rates for incomes up to 5 minimum wages. Repayment starts after graduation with grace period.
programmes.deadline_note: Semiannual selection windows; requires Enem from 2010 with average score of at least 450 and essay above zero.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply in the Fies selection at the Portal Único de Acesso ao Ensino Superior (gov.br)
If pre-selected, deliver documents at the higher education institution within the deadline
Sign the contract at Caixa and renew each semester

documents_required.doc: Enem result (from 2010) with 450+ average and essay above zero
Income documents of the family group
RG, CPF and proof of residence of student and family members

eligibility.income_note: Per capita family income up to 3 minimum wages (Fies) or 5 minimum wages (P-Fies); private HEI courses with positive MEC evaluation

programmes.source_snippet: Taxa de juros ZERO para todos os estudantes; sem necessidade de fiador se sua renda familiar for até 1,5 salário mínimo por pessoa.

programmes.name_en: University for All - full and partial scholarships at private universities
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (MEC)
programmes.amount_note: Full scholarships (100%) for per capita family income up to 1.5 minimum wage; partial scholarships (50%) for income up to 3 minimum wages; requires Enem average of at least 450 points and essay above zero.
programmes.deadline_note: Two selection processes per year (1st and 2nd semester), using Enem scores.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the ProUni portal during the semiannual window with gov.br login
If pre-selected, deliver income and schooling documents at the institution
Enrol with the full or partial scholarship

documents_required.doc: Enem result (450+ average, essay above zero)
Proof of public high school or full private-school scholarship

eligibility.income_note: Bolsa integral: per capita income up to 1.5 minimum wage; bolsa parcial: up to 3 minimum wages; full high school at public school or as full scholarship holder, PCD or public-school teachers for licenciatura

programmes.source_snippet: Bolsa integral (100%): renda familiar bruta mensal per capita de até 1,5 salário mínimo; bolsa parcial (50%): até 3 salários mínimos.

programmes.name_local: Isenção da Taxa de Inscrição do Enem
programmes.name_en: Enem registration fee waiver
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação / Inep
programmes.amount_note: Full waiver of the Enem registration fee (R$ 85 in 2025) for students completing public high school, CadÚnico members and low-income candidates.
programmes.deadline_note: Waiver request window opens before Enem registration each year (usually April); unjustified absence in the previous edition blocks a new waiver.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the waiver at the Página do Participante during the waiver window
Inep cross-checks CadÚnico/public school data
If denied, file an appeal within the deadline or pay the fee

documents_required.doc: CPF and personal data matching Receita Federal records
CadÚnico registration or proof of public high school enrolment

eligibility.income_note: Students in the last year of public high school; candidates registered in CadÚnico or with low income (per capita up to half minimum wage)

programmes.source_snippet: Estudantes que estão cursando o último ano do ensino médio em escolas públicas, assim como aqueles que comprovaram ser de baixa renda ou inscritos no CadÚnico, têm direito à isenção.

programmes.name_local: Política Nacional de Assistência Estudantil (PNAES) - Auxílios Permanência
programmes.name_en: National Student Assistance Policy - housing, food and transport grants at federal universities/institutes
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação; executada pelas IFES (universidades e institutos federais)
programmes.amount_note: Monthly permanence grants (auxílio moradia, alimentação, transporte, creche) defined by each federal institution's own student assistance programme; typical values range from R$ 300 to R$ 800 per month depending on the modality and institution.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at the student assistance sector (pró-reitoria de assuntos estudantis) of your federal university/institute; socioeconomic evaluation required.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol at a federal university or instituto federal
Apply for student assistance at the institution's PRAE and submit to socioeconomic evaluation
If selected, receive monthly auxílio or in-kind support (housing, meals, transport)

documents_required.doc: Proof of enrolment at the IFES
Proof of residence and housing costs

eligibility.income_note: Lei n.º 14.914/2024 (PNAES): the Bolsa Permanência requires monthly per-capita household income not above 1 minimum wage, and the Programa de Assistência Estudantil uses gross monthly per-capita income up to 1 minimum wage with a priority band at up to half. 2026 minimum wage R$1,621.00 x 12 = R$19,452/year per person (priority band R$9,726/yr).

programmes.source_snippet: A Pnaes garante ações de assistência estudantil nas instituições federais de ensino superior, incluindo auxílios moradia, transporte e alimentação para estudantes em vulnerabilidade socioeconômica.

programmes.name_local: Lei de Cotas (Lei nº 12.711/2012) - Reserva de Vagas nas Universidades Federais
programmes.name_en: Quota Law - reserved places at federal universities and institutes for public-school students
programmes.funder: Ministério da Educação (aplicada pelas IFES via Sisu e vestibulares próprios)
programmes.amount_note: At least 50% of places in each course at federal universities and institutos federais reserved for students who completed all of high school in public schools, subdivided by income (up to 1.5 minimum wage per capita) and race/ethnicity; minimum 25% of the reserved places for low-income candidates.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically at enrolment in Sisu or the institution's own selection; annual windows.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Sisu or the federal institution's vestibular choosing the quota modality
If approved, present proof of public high school completion (and income/race declaration where applicable)
Enrol in the reserved place

documents_required.doc: Full high school transcript from public schools

eligibility.income_note: Lei n.º 12.711/2012 as amended by Lei n.º 14.723/2023: half of the reserved places go to students from families with income at or below 1 minimum wage per capita (lowered from the original 1.5). 2026 minimum wage R$1,621.00 x 12 = R$19,452/year per person. The other half of reserved places has no income condition.

programmes.source_snippet: Art. 1º As instituições federais de educação superior vinculadas ao Ministério da Educação reservarão, no mínimo, 50% de suas vagas para estudantes oriundos integralmente de escola pública.

programmes.name_local: Gratuidade no Transporte Coletivo para Idosos (65+)
programmes.name_en: Free public transport for seniors aged 65+ (Estatuto do Idoso)
programmes.funder: Poder público municipal/estadual e empresas concessionárias (Lei nº 10.741/2003, art. 39)
programmes.amount_note: Free urban public transport (buses, and in most cities metro/trains) for persons aged 65 or over, upon presentation of an identity document; some municipalities extend to 60+ (e.g. São Paulo city, Rio de Janeiro).
programmes.deadline_note: Issue the senior/free-fare card at the municipal transport authority or just present ID where accepted.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the rule of your municipality (65+ nationally; some cities 60+)
Issue the free-fare card (e.g. Bilhete Único Idoso, Riocard Gratuidade) at the transport operator or just board with ID
Use public transport free of charge

documents_required.doc: Identity document with photo proving age

eligibility.income_note: All persons aged 65+ regardless of income (some municipalities grant from age 60)

programmes.source_snippet: Art. 39. É assegurada, no sistema de transporte coletivo, a gratuidade aos maiores de 65 anos... reservados 10% dos assentos, devidamente identificados.

programmes.name_local: Passe Livre Interestadual para Pessoa com Deficiência
programmes.name_en: Free interstate travel pass for persons with disabilities in economic hardship
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Lei nº 8.899/1994); regulado pela ANTT
programmes.amount_note: Full fare exemption on interstate collective road transport for persons with disability with per capita family income up to one minimum wage; companion may travel free when medically justified.
programmes.deadline_note: Credential issued digitally by ANTT after document analysis; keep CadÚnico updated.

procedure_steps.detail: Update CadÚnico and gather medical report of the disability
Apply at the ANTT Passe Livre system
After approval, present the digital credential when buying the interstate ticket

documents_required.doc: CadÚnico registration (income up to 1 minimum wage per capita)

eligibility.income_note: Persons with disability with per capita family income up to one minimum wage (hipossuficiência econômica)

programmes.source_snippet: Benefício que garante gratuidade no transporte coletivo interestadual para pessoas com deficiência que comprovem situação de hipossuficiência econômica.

programmes.name_en: Transport Voucher - employer-funded commuting benefit with 6% payroll deduction
programmes.funder: Empregador (obrigação legal); regulado pelo Ministério do Trabalho
programmes.amount_note: Employer must advance the full cost of commuting from home to work and back; the worker pays at most 6% of the basic salary via payroll deduction, the remainder being subsidised by the employer.
programmes.deadline_note: Inform the employer at hiring the address and transport lines used.

procedure_steps.detail: At hiring, fill the vale-transporte declaration with your address and daily routes
Employer provides tickets/credits monthly
Up to 6% of basic salary is deducted from payroll

documents_required.doc: Declaration of address and transport lines used

eligibility.income_note: Lei n.º 7.418/1985 sets no income ceiling: every employee is entitled, with the worker paying up to 6% of basic salary and the employer covering the excess commuting cost.

programmes.source_snippet: O empregador antecipará ao empregado o Vale-Transporte para utilização efetiva em despesas de deslocamento residência-trabalho e vice-versa, com desconto de até 6% do salário básico.

programmes.name_local: Meia-Entrada (Estatuto da Juventude / Estatuto do Idoso / LBI)
programmes.name_en: Half-price tickets for students, seniors, persons with disabilities and young people in poverty
programmes.funder: Poder público (Lei nº 12.933/2013; Lei nº 10.741/2003; Lei nº 13.146/2015) - pagos pelos promotores de eventos
programmes.amount_note: Half-price admission to artistic, cultural and sports events for students, seniors 60+, persons with disabilities (and companion when needed) and young people 15-29 in poverty (ID Jovem). Category: leisure/culture access benefit.
programmes.deadline_note: Students present the student ID (CIE); low-income youth issue the free ID Jovem online; seniors present ID.

procedure_steps.detail: Students: issue the Carteira de Identificação Estudantil (CIE/ANE/UBES) with the entities
Low-income youth 15-29: issue the ID Jovem free at gov.br (CadÚnico required)
Present the document when buying the ticket

documents_required.doc: Student ID (CIE) with validity or ID Jovem

eligibility.income_note: Students, persons 60+, PCDs and young people 15-29 in poverty (ID Jovem: CadÚnico, per capita income up to 2 minimum wages)

programmes.source_snippet: O benefício da meia-entrada é assegurado ao estudante, ao idoso, à pessoa com deficiência e ao jovem de baixa renda, nos termos da Lei nº 12.933/2013.

programmes.name_en: People's Pharmacy - free and subsidised medicines
programmes.funder: Ministério da Saúde; rede própria e rede credenciada 'Aqui Tem Farmácia Popular'
programmes.amount_note: Free medicines (100% subsidy) for hypertension, diabetes and asthma; contraceptives and other items free; copayment discounts of up to 90% for dyslipidemia, rhinitis, Parkinson's, osteoporosis, glaucoma and adult diapers.
programmes.deadline_note: Present a valid prescription, CPF and photo ID at any accredited pharmacy or Farmácia Popular unit.

procedure_steps.detail: Get a prescription from SUS or a private doctor
Go to an accredited 'Aqui Tem Farmácia Popular' pharmacy or a PFPB unit
Present prescription, CPF and ID; free items are dispensed at no cost

eligibility.income_note: All Brazilian residents with a valid prescription; no income test

programmes.source_snippet: Programa Farmácia Popular do Brasil disponibiliza medicamentos gratuitos para o tratamento de diabetes, asma e hipertensão.

programmes.name_local: Componente Especializado da Assistência Farmacêutica (Medicamentos de Alto Custo - SUS)
programmes.name_en: SUS high-cost specialised medicines (CEAF)
programmes.funder: Ministério da Saúde e secretarias estaduais de saúde
programmes.amount_note: Free dispensing of high-cost specialised medicines (oncology, rare diseases, hepatitis, multiple sclerosis, immunosuppressants, etc.) through state pharmacies under SUS clinical protocols.
programmes.deadline_note: Requires SUS prescription and specific clinical documentation (LME) at the state specialised pharmacy.

procedure_steps.detail: Consult at a SUS specialised service and obtain the protocol prescription
Submit the LME (Relatório de Solicitação) and documents at the state/municipal specialised pharmacy
Collect the medicine free of charge periodically

documents_required.doc: LME report filled by the SUS physician
CPF, ID and proof of residence
Exams and clinical documents per protocol

eligibility.income_note: All SUS users with clinical indication under the PCDT protocols; no income test

programmes.source_snippet: O Componente Especializado da Assistência Farmacêutica garante medicamentos estratégicos e de alto custo gratuitamente à população, conforme Protocolos Clínicos e Diretrizes Terapêuticas.

programmes.name_local: Brasil Sorridente (Política Nacional de Saúde Bucal - SUS)
programmes.name_en: Smiling Brazil - free oral health care in SUS
programmes.funder: Ministério da Saúde
programmes.amount_note: Free dental treatment in the SUS network: check-ups, cleaning, fillings, extractions, root canals (in Centros de Especialidades Odontológicas), prostheses and oral cancer diagnosis.
programmes.deadline_note: Register at the UBS (basic health unit) of your area; specialised care by referral.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the UBS near your home and book a dental appointment
Receive basic treatment at the UBS
If needed, be referred to a Centro de Especialidades Odontológicas (CEO) free of charge

eligibility.income_note: All SUS users; no income test

programmes.source_snippet: A Política Nacional de Saúde Bucal (Brasil Sorridente) garante ações de promoção, prevenção e tratamento odontológico gratuito na rede SUS.

programmes.name_en: Health Academy - free supervised physical activity and health promotion poles
programmes.funder: Ministério da Saúde e municípios
programmes.amount_note: Free guided physical activity, gymnastics, dance and health promotion classes at public poles (parks and squares) for the whole population, prioritising people with chronic diseases.
programmes.deadline_note: Enrol directly at the pole or through the local UBS.

procedure_steps.detail: Find the Academia da Saúde pole in your municipality
Enrol at the pole or via referral from the UBS
Join the free guided activities

eligibility.income_note: Open to the entire population; no income or age test

programmes.source_snippet: O Programa Academia da Saúde oferece gratuitamente espaços públicos com profissionais qualificados para a prática de atividade física e promoção da saúde.

programmes.name_local: Programa de Proteção e Promoção da Saúde Menstrual (Dignidade Menstrual)
programmes.name_en: Menstrual Dignity - free period products for students and vulnerable women
programmes.funder: Ministério da Saúde / Ministério das Mulheres (Lei nº 14.214/2021)
programmes.amount_note: Free menstrual pads distributed through public schools, health units and social assistance network to low-income students and women in vulnerable situations (street situation, incarcerated, CadÚnico).
programmes.deadline_note: Distribution via enrolled public schools, UBSs and CRAS; no individual application in most cases.

procedure_steps.detail: Public-school students receive at school (registered networks)
Women in vulnerability receive at UBS or CRAS
No payment involved; products dispensed free

documents_required.doc: Enrolment in public school or CadÚnico registration

eligibility.income_note: Low-income students of public schools and women in situations of vulnerability registered in CadÚnico

programmes.source_snippet: O programa garante a distribuição gratuita de absorventes a estudantes de baixa renda de escolas públicas e a mulheres em situação de vulnerabilidade (Lei nº 14.214/2021).

programmes.name_local: Isenção e Redução do Imposto de Renda (Lei nº 15.270/2025)
programmes.name_en: Income tax exemption up to R$ 5.000/month and reduction up to R$ 7.350
programmes.funder: Receita Federal do Brasil
programmes.amount_note: From 2026: zero income tax for monthly income up to R$ 5.000 (maximum relief of R$ 978,62/month) and progressive reduction for income up to R$ 7.350/month; applied automatically in payroll and annual return.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic in payroll from January 2026; compensated in the annual adjustment declaration.

procedure_steps.detail: No action needed: payroll applies the exemption automatically
Self-employed/other incomes: benefit computed in the annual IRPF declaration

eligibility.income_note: Monthly taxable income up to R$ 5.000 (full exemption) with tapering reduction up to R$ 7.350; partial financing by taxation of high incomes

programmes.source_snippet: A Lei nº 15.270/2025 institui redução do imposto sobre a renda das pessoas físicas, com isenção para rendimentos mensais de até R$ 5.000.

programmes.name_local: Isenção de Imposto de Renda por Doença Grave (Aposentados/Pensionistas)
programmes.name_en: Income tax exemption on retirement/pension for serious diseases
programmes.funder: Receita Federal do Brasil (Lei nº 7.713/1988, art. 6º, XIV)
programmes.amount_note: Full exemption of income tax on retirement, pension or reform income for persons with specified serious diseases (cancer, AIDS, Parkinson's, active tuberculosis, severe cardiopathy, mental alienation, etc.).
programmes.deadline_note: Requires medical report from an official health service (SUS/INSS/military) proving the disease; process via e-CAC or INSS/paying source.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain medical report (laudo) issued by an official medical service proving the disease
Request the exemption at the paying source (INSS Dataprev/employer) or via Receita e-CAC
Exemption applies to retirement/pension income

documents_required.doc: Medical report of serious disease issued by official service
CPF and proof of retirement/pension income

eligibility.income_note: Retired persons and pensioners with diseases listed in the law; private-sector (complementação) incomes also covered

programmes.source_snippet: São isentos do imposto sobre a renda os rendimentos de aposentadoria, reforma e pensão percebidos por portadores de moléstia grave, conforme o art. 6º, XIV, da Lei nº 7.713/1988.

programmes.name_local: Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) - Formalização com Tributos Reduzidos
programmes.name_en: Individual Microentrepreneur - simplified registration, tax exemption on opening and reduced monthly tax
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Receita Federal / Sebrae como parceiro) - LC nº 123/2006
programmes.amount_note: Free registration (no opening fees) and a single monthly DAS payment of about R$ 56-66 (INSS 5% of minimum wage + ICMS R$ 1 commerce/industry + ISS R$ 5 services); exemption from federal taxes on revenue and access to INSS benefits with reduced contribution.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual revenue limit of R$ 81.000; monthly DAS due on the 20th; annual DASN-SIMEI declaration required.

procedure_steps.detail: Register free at the Portal do Empreendedor (gov.br)
Receive CNPJ, alvará and state registration immediately
Pay the monthly DAS and file the annual declaration (DASN-SIMEI)

documents_required.doc: Título de eleitor or last IRPF receipt

eligibility.income_note: Self-employed in permitted activities with annual revenue up to R$ 81.000 and at most 1 employee; cannot be partner/owner of another company

programmes.source_snippet: A formalização é gratuita e o MEI paga mensalmente um valor fixo que inclui INSS, ICMS e/ou ISS, com direito a benefícios previdenciários.

programmes.name_en: Simples Nacional - unified reduced tax regime for micro and small enterprises
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Comitê Gestor do Simples Nacional / Receita Federal) - LC nº 123/2006
programmes.amount_note: Unified monthly payment (DAS) covering 8 federal, state and municipal taxes with progressive rates starting at 4% (commerce), 4,5% (industry) and 6% (services) of revenue - substantially below the regular regimes.
programmes.deadline_note: Option for the regime made in January each year (30-day window for existing companies); ME up to R$ 360 mil and EPP up to R$ 4,8 mi annual revenue.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility (activity and revenue limits) at the Simples Nacional portal
Request the option in January or at company opening
Calculate and pay the unified DAS monthly via PGDAS-D app

documents_required.doc: Regularity of federal, state and municipal debts

eligibility.income_note: Microenterprises (ME, revenue up to R$ 360 mil/year) and small enterprises (EPP, up to R$ 4,8 mi/year) in permitted activities

programmes.source_snippet: Regime tributário compartilhado de arrecadação, cobrança e fiscalização, aplicável às Microempresas e Empresas de Pequeno Porte, previsto na LC nº 123/2006.

programmes.name_local: CrediAmigo - Microcrédito Produtivo do Banco do Nordeste
programmes.name_en: CrediAmigo - productive microcredit of Banco do Nordeste
programmes.funder: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil (Programa Nacional de Microcrédito Produtivo Orientado - PNMPO)
programmes.amount_note: Productive microcredit loans roughly from R$ 500 to R$ 25.000+ for working capital and investment, with below-market rates and group or individual modalities; technical guidance included.
programmes.deadline_note: Business visit by the bank's microcredit agent (agente de microcrédito) at the client's location.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact CrediAmigo via the Banco do Nordeste site or a branch; an agent visits your business
Socioeconomic evaluation and credit proposal
Sign the contract and receive the funds; repay in instalments

documents_required.doc: Proof of residence and of business activity

eligibility.income_note: Microentrepreneurs (formal or informal) in urban or rural areas; serves the North, Northeast and other regions where BNB operates

programmes.source_snippet: O CrediAmigo é o programa de microcrédito produtivo orientado do Banco do Nordeste, voltado a microempreendedores urbanos e rurais.

programmes.name_local: Programa Nacional de Microcrédito Produtivo Orientado (PNMPO)
programmes.name_en: National Oriented Productive Microcredit Programme
programmes.funder: Governo Federal (Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego); operado por bancos públicos (Caixa, BB, BNB, Basa) e agentes credenciados
programmes.amount_note: Microcredit up to R$ 21.000 (higher with guarantee) for working capital and investment of microentrepreneurs, with mandatory technical guidance (orientação) and subsidised rates.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at microcredit agents of public banks or accredited institutions.

procedure_steps.detail: Look for a microcredit agent (Caixa, Banco do Brasil, BNB, Banco da Amazônia or OSCIPs)
Agent visits and evaluates the business (microcrédito produtivo orientado)
Credit released with follow-up technical guidance

documents_required.doc: Proof of business activity and residence

eligibility.income_note: Formal or informal microentrepreneurs with annual gross revenue up to R$ 360.000

programmes.source_snippet: O PNMPO orienta e financia microempreendedores formais e informais, combinando crédito produtivo com assistência técnica.

programmes.name_local: Programa Nacional de Fortalecimento da Agricultura Familiar (Pronaf)
programmes.name_en: Pronaf - subsidised credit for family farming
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar (MDA); operado por bancos oficiais
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised rural credit for family farmers: Pronaf Custeio (working capital, up to R$ 250 mil), Pronaf Investimento (up to R$ 500 mil), Pronaf Agroecologia/Mulher/Jovem/Bioeconomia with special conditions; interest typically around 5-6% a.a. in the Safra Plan.
programmes.deadline_note: Credit lines opened each Plano Safra (July-June); requires DAP/CAF.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain the Declaração de Aptidão ao Pronaf (DAP/CAF) at Emater, sindicato rural or Sebrae
Take the project to an official bank (BB, Caixa, BNB, cooperatives)
Sign the contract with subsidised interest and pay per harvest calendar

documents_required.doc: CPF, ID and proof of rural activity
Property or possession documents of the land

eligibility.income_note: Family farmers fitting the DAP criteria (management by the family, majority of income from the property, limited area and income)

programmes.source_snippet: O Pronaf é o programa do Governo Federal de apoio à agricultura familiar, com linhas de crédito de custeio e investimento a juros subvencionados.

programmes.name_local: Programa Nacional de Apoio ao Médio Produtor Rural (Pronamp)
programmes.name_en: Pronamp - subsidised credit for medium rural producers
programmes.funder: Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária (MAPA); operado por bancos oficiais
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised working-capital and investment credit for medium rural producers with annual gross revenue up to R$ 3 milhões (investment limit around R$ 430 mil per beneficiary per year); interest around 8% a.a. in the Safra Plan.
programmes.deadline_note: Lines opened each Plano Safra (July-June).

procedure_steps.detail: Take the financing proposal to an official bank or cooperative
Prove medium-producer condition (annual gross revenue up to R$ 3 milhões)
Contract costeio or investment credit with subsidised interest

documents_required.doc: Proof of rural activity and revenue

eligibility.income_note: Medium rural producers with annual gross revenue up to R$ 3.000.000

programmes.source_snippet: O Pronamp financia custeio e investimento do médio produtor rural com receita bruta anual de até R$ 3 milhões, com juros subvencionados no Plano Safra.

programmes.name_en: Desenrola Brasil - debt renegotiation programme with discounts
programmes.funder: Ministério da Fazenda (MP nº 1.355/2026); operado pelos bancos e pela Caixa
programmes.amount_note: Renegotiation of overdue debts (credit card, overdraft, personal credit, Fies) contracted until 31/01/2026 and overdue 91-720 days: discounts from 30% to 90%, new credit at max 1.99% a.m., up to 48 instalments, limit of R$ 15 mil per bank; optional use of FGTS (up to R$ 1 mil or 20% of balance).
programmes.deadline_note: Programme with a 90-day adherence window counted from the MP publication (May 2026); Desenrola Fies adherence until 31/12/2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Check your overdue debts with your banks
Renegotiate through official channels: gov.br, Caixa Tem or your bank
Pay at sight (bigger discount) or in up to 48 instalments; name cleared within 5 days after first payment

documents_required.doc: Proof of income up to 5 minimum wages

eligibility.income_note: Individuals with monthly income up to 5 minimum wages with eligible overdue debts; also micro and small enterprises in specific tracks

programmes.source_snippet: Descontos aplicados sobre o valor da dívida original; taxa de juros de 1,99% ao mês; prazos de pagamento entre 12 e 48 meses; parcela mínima de R$ 50,00.

programmes.name_en: Cisterns Programme - free water tanks for semi-arid families
programmes.funder: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS); executado por entidades e estados
programmes.amount_note: Free construction of 16.000-litre plate cisterns for drinking water and cisterns for production (52.000 litres, calçadão) for low-income rural families in the Semi-arid region.
programmes.deadline_note: Families are indicated by municipal committees/executing entities from CadÚnico; no direct application.

procedure_steps.detail: Register in CadÚnico at the CRAS of your rural municipality
Municipal management committee selects beneficiary families
Executing entity builds the cistern with family participation

eligibility.income_note: Low-income rural families registered in CadÚnico living in the Semi-arid region; priority to Bolsa Família and BPC families

programmes.source_snippet: O Programa Cisternas financia a construção de tecnologias sociais de acesso à água para consumo humano e produção de alimentos no Semiárido brasileiro.

programmes.name_local: Tarifa Social de Água e Esgoto - Sabesp (Tarifa Residencial Social e Vulnerável)
programmes.name_en: Sabesp social water and sewage tariff
programmes.funder: Sabesp (contrato de concessão com o Estado de São Paulo)
programmes.amount_note: Fixed social tariff for up to 10 m³/month: R$ 16,42 (Vulnerável, per capita income up to R$ 218) or R$ 21 (Social, income up to half minimum wage) - discounts up to about 78% versus the standard residential tariff.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically via CadÚnico cross-check; CPF of the bill holder must match the CadÚnico registration; one property per family.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Ensure the Sabesp bill holder's CPF matches the CadÚnico
Discount applies automatically; if not, request at Sabesp with the NIS

eligibility.income_note: CadÚnico families in the Sabesp concession area: Vulnerável up to R$ 218 per capita; Social from R$ 218 to half minimum wage per capita

programmes.source_snippet: Famílias de baixa renda podem reduzir custos, pagando de R$ 16,42 a R$ 21 pelo consumo mensal de até 10 m³, conforme a renda registrada no CadÚnico.

programmes.name_local: Tarifa Social de Água - Copasa (Minas Gerais)
programmes.name_en: Copasa social water tariff (Minas Gerais)
programmes.funder: Copasa (Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais) / Estado de Minas Gerais
programmes.amount_note: Reduced social tariff on water and sewage for low-income families registered in CadÚnico in municipalities served by Copasa; discount varies by consumption band.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied via CadÚnico cross-check; request at Copasa agencies or service channels if not automatic.

procedure_steps.detail: Register/update CadÚnico at the CRAS
Request the social tariff at Copasa (agency, site or call center) with the NIS
Discount applied to the monthly bill

eligibility.income_note: Low-income families in CadÚnico served by Copasa; per capita income limits defined in the concession contract
